catalogue_title: From Hawking to Marchenko–Pastur: A Guide to the Page Curve and Beyond
title: From Hawking to Marchenko–Pastur: A Guide to the Page Curve and Beyond
label: Black hole information
abstract_html: This tutorial develops the Page curve program from quantum entanglement and Hawking radiation to holographic entropy, replica wormholes, and random matrix theory. We derive the normalized random-state benchmark and its Marchenko–Pastur limit, explaining the roles of non-crossing partitions and spectral resolvents. We then distinguish averaging conditional entropies from calculating the entropy of a state with fluctuating energy or area. Gaussian broadening, finite reservoirs, and a quartic critical model illustrate how the preparation and the fluctuation law enter this distinction. Exact finite-dimensional examples separate averaged spectra from ensemble fluctuations and radiation data for one input from information about a quantum channel. Normalized annealed and quenched Rényi entropies have a common von Neumann limit, while their finite-order difference and connected replica moments measure additional ensemble information. Throughout, explicit calculations are distinguished from gravitational applications that require further assumptions. The resulting account provides a self-contained introduction to the established methods and to the remaining questions about microscopic information recovery.
